title: Add batch-2 FP guards: sentence-case action captions + PK Get is transaction-cached
summary: Two knowledge articles were added to guide developers about correct use of sentence-case action captions and transaction-cached primary key lookups, helping suppress false positive quality warnings.
key_points: Action captions that express imperative commands should use sentence case (capitalize only the first word and proper nouns), not title case
Primary key Get calls within a transaction are already cached by the system and do not require manual dictionary caching when used per-row
Knowledge articles with example code help developers understand when and why certain coding patterns are correct
These articles address feedback from Business Central app maintainers about false positive quality rule flagging
Knowledge index was updated to include the two new articles
quote: Two knowledge articles that suppress false positives thumbs-downed by BCApps maintainers.
